message: Just as Setsugekka finished eating the fried rice, I headed to the classroom.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Pfft—！？ M-Muragaki-henhe-！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, yeah, don't worry about it. Just enjoy the flavor.」
I flash her a friendly smile.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「*Gulp*... *phew*, that was delicious.」
Setsugekka takes a breath with a look of pure bliss on her face.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Um, sensei... what was that fried rice just now？」

name: Iori
message: 「I made it. It’s the Tenju Special Forces specialty, <d0050>Muragaki Fried Rice</d>.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「O-oh, really！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「It was super delicious, the shrimp and everything else in it was exquisite...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Is that so? I’m glad you liked it.」
With that, the first phase of the plan has been cleared without a hitch.

name: Iori
message: 「By the way, there’s more of that fried rice if you want seconds.」
I show Setsugekka the large bowl I had been hiding behind my back.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, are you sure...！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, don't hold back. Eat plenty to make up for all the meals you've missed.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yay, thank you for the m—」

name: Iori
message: 「However, there are conditions.」

name: Iori
message: 「From now on, you will come to the classroom every morning and accept my instruction properly.」

name: Iori
message: 「You will follow my guidance even if you have complaints.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you can follow those rules, I’ll give you this special fried rice.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-what did you say...！？」
Setsugekka’s face twitches.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Wait, sensei, you just said ‘make up for what you missed,’ didn’t you？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Don’t tell me, you know that my diet is currently being restricted！？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yes, of course I do.」

name: Iori
message: 「Because I’m the one who placed those restrictions on your diet, Setsugekka.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Was it youuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I was so sure it was Kei-chan’s doing！」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m the one who asked Keisetsu to cooperate.」

name: Iori
message: 「When I explained the situation, she was happy to help out.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Mmph, I never expected you and Kei-chan to be in cahoots, Teach…！」

name: Iori
message: 「Now you see, don’t you, Setsugekka.」

name: Iori
message: 「A homeroom teacher at Murakumo Academy, if they really want to, can control what their students eat as much as they like.」

name: Iori
message: 「If you don’t comply, you won’t be tasting anything but <d0051>low-carb menus</d> for the next three years.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「How cruel！ Don’t I have any human rights～！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「You enemy of the people, depriving humanity of carbohydrates！ I’ll never forgive yooou！」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you sure？ Don’t you want to eat this fried rice？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ggh… It’s true that I want to eat that special fried rice, *drool*」

name: Iori
message: 「Come on now, let me give you a bite.」
I scoop up some fried rice with a Chinese spoon and bring it to Setsugekka’s lips.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, uuu~ no good, I can’t resist the temptation of the fried rice~~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Chomp」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, wow, this is so goood… this is even better than what you get at a restaurant！」
Setsugekka makes a face like she’s in absolute bliss.

name: Iori
message: 「If you follow my guidance, you can have this every week.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Eh, every week！？ Seriously！？ You’ll make it for me？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I’ll make my special fried rice just for you every weekend.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughnn… that’s too tempting…！」

name: Iori
message: 「If your progress under my guidance goes smoothly, I’ll lift the low-carb menu restrictions too.」

name: Iori
message: 「What do you say？ Are you finally willing to show up properly every morning？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I-I’ll come, I mean, I’ll go！ I’ll make sure to show up for class！」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, a deal's a deal, Setsugekka」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughhh~ I feel like I'm being scammed somehow...」

name: Iori
message: 「Here, eat as much as you want」
I handed her a bowl piled high with my special fried rice.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Nom nom nom... yummm！ So fragrant！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahaha, well, I'm happy, so I guess the little details don't matter！」
And thus, the operation to win over Setsugekka was successfully completed.
